summary: Filer Ares Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 to provide an update on net asset value per share and portfolio information. The filing announces the August 1, 2026 transaction price equal to NAV per share as of June 30, 2026. The board engaged Altus Group as independent valuation advisor for monthly appraisals and valuations. It discloses NAV per share for each class, posted on the website and telephone line. No special-situation event—acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes—is present. The filing is a routine periodic NAV disclosure for a non-listed REIT, without any structural or transactional change.
